Container.Name: reauth-bot
Container.Overview: Auto-reauth bot for Tape (tape#16). Self-contained image (reauth.py + seed noVNC tooling baked in). On a ~72h cadence it drives Tape's own /v1/admin/login flow inside a persistent trusted-device profile (skips 2FA) so the Schwab 7-day consent refreshes itself. One bot for the whole deploy (single Schwab app/token). REQUIRES a one-time interactive trusted-device seed: set SEED_MODE=1 + SEED_VNC_PASSWORD, Apply, complete the consent over noVNC (http://CONTAINER-IP:6080/vnc.html), then clear SEED_MODE and Apply. The trusted-device cookie MUST persist across updates (Profile volume). See ops/reauth/README.md.
Container.Description: Auto-reauth bot — maintains the Schwab OAuth token for Tape. Self-contained image; UI-deployed; one-time seed via SEED_MODE. See ops/reauth/README.md.

Config.Name: Profile
Config.Description: Trusted-device browser profile + /profile/shots debug captures (persist across updates; root-only, holds brokerage imagery)

Config.Name: SCHWAB_USER
Config.Description: Schwab login id (drives the trusted-device browser login)

Config.Name: TAPE_LOGIN_URL
Config.Description: Tape login endpoint the bot navigates to start consent

Config.Name: TAPE_TOKEN_URL
Config.Description: Tape token-status endpoint the bot reads to confirm refresh_issued_at advanced

Config.Name: REAUTH_NTFY_URL
Config.Description: Full ntfy topic URL for success/failure pushes (unset = log-only)

Config.Name: REAUTH_INTERVAL_HOURS
Config.Description: Refresh cadence in hours (~3d = 2+ tries per 7-day Schwab window)

Config.Name: REAUTH_RETRY_HOURS
Config.Description: Retry interval after a failed run, in hours

Config.Name: SEED_MODE
Config.Description: Set to 1 ONLY for the one-time interactive seed (headed browser over noVNC on :6080); blank = headless steady state

Config.Name: SEED_VNC_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Required when SEED_MODE=1 — VNC password gating noVNC (the seed is a live brokerage login on br0). Blank refuses to start in seed mode.

Config.Name: REAUTH_SEED_HOLD_SECONDS
Config.Description: How long (s) the seed keeps the headed browser open for you to log in + approve 2FA. Raise if a slow SMS 2FA risks closing it mid-login.

Config.Name: Seed noVNC
Config.Description: noVNC port, used ONLY during the seed (SEED_MODE=1). On br0 reach it at http://CONTAINER-IP:6080/vnc.html.

Config.Name: SEL_USER
Config.Description: Optional: username field CSS selector (blank = default #loginIdInput)

Config.Name: SEL_CONSENT
Config.Description: Optional: consent/allow button selector list (blank = image default)

Config.Name: SEL_2FA
Config.Description: Optional: selector(s) detecting a re-appeared 2FA prompt (blank = image default). Gates the 're-seed required' alarm.
